name: My Beloved!
source:
'My Beloved!' tells the story of Glenn; As a young boy, he struggled to find a place where he felt loved, felt like he belonged... The first change came when he met Daniel. A trusted soul whom he could trust and confide in, who sheltered him from life's unkindness.

The the second change came... Life is complicated though. Relationships, communication, understanding... These can be the tree trunks that support us, or the vines that strangle us. Will Glenn be smothered in the dark and the shadows again? Or will he find his Beloved!

The story begins with another young man, who leaves home just after his eighteenth birthday, determined to learn the truth behind his father's scorn.

[From Itch.io]
translation:
“我的爱人！”讲述格伦的故事；作为一个小男孩，他努力寻找一个让他感到被爱、有归属感的地方……第一个变化是在他遇到丹尼尔时发生的。一个他可以信任和倾诉的值得信赖的灵魂，他保护他免受生活的不友善。

第二个变化来了……生活虽然很复杂。关系、沟通、理解……这些可以是支撑我们的树干，也可以是勒死我们的藤蔓。格伦会再次被黑暗和阴影窒息吗？或者他会找到他的挚爱！

故事始于另一位年轻人，他刚过十八岁生日就离家出走，决心了解父亲蔑视背后的真相。

[来自Itch.io]
